fields.label: Statistic
fields.description: The submitted statistic the driver value was read from. Blank for a fixed-weight driver.

fields.label: Value Period
fields.description: The fiscal period the driver value comes from. Differs from the run's period only when carried forward.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where the driver value came from: Uploaded Statistic, Fixed Weights or Account Set.

fields.label: Effective From
fields.description: For Fixed Weights: the start of the window used.

fields.label: Basis
fields.description: Share of Pool or Declared Rate, as the rule declared at Compute.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Amount per driver unit, from the rule set's rates at Compute.

fields.label: Rate From
fields.description: Start of the rate window used.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: This receiver's share of the sender's pool at this step, as a fraction.
